card.name: Linking words before other CNS depressants
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, of, including, or e.g., right before the phrase 'other CNS depressants' in drug interaction and sedation warnings. It also fires on 'non' before 'selective MAO inhibitors'.

modes.label: Before CNS depressants
modes.description: A linking word after 'use', 'used', or 'combination' that leads into 'other CNS depressants'.
modes.example: especially when used<< with>> other CNS depressants including alcohol.

modes.label: List openers
modes.description: Punctuation or 'including' that opens a list of example depressant drugs.
modes.example: concomitant use of other CNS depressants (e.g<<.,>> other benzodiazepines, opioids

card.writes: It seems to suppress 'base'-type words, which makes little sense, so there is no clear output effect beyond expecting 'other' drug-class terms.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before 'other sedating drugs' in warnings about combining sedatives.
